# SemanticRelationTemporalGraph

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A graph representation of semantic associations where nodes are concepts and edge weights encode temporal co-occurrence or sequential dependency strengths. Enables TCC-based topological analysis of semantic flow, allowing neuromorphic hardware to process linguistic structure as spatial-temporal patterns.
